items.title: The subobject generated by terms of degree at most n, and vanishing of its normalized part above n
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file simplicial.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: Subobject lemma (statement 2309-2321, proof 2323-2352): the subobject generated by images of structure maps into degrees <= n is a simplicial subobject agreeing with U up to n and with zero normalized part above n - stability is one line, the vanishing uses the splitting lemma (card L46157) and a factorization of the defining maps; no verification is omitted. H2: structural bookkeeping over the splitting.
